Maria (CS): Heads-up — Asterion Labs renewal. They asked to shorten to 3 mo and pay by credit card; procurement says PO required. Need guidance on approval path and invoice split for EU entity. @Linh can you confirm commit terms?
Jake - RevOps: Can we accept CC for partial? We usually allow CC <= $25k. What's ARR and renewal amount?
Maria (CS): Renewal UI shows $38,200 annual -> pro-rated for 3mo = $9,550. Customer wants immediate access, no PO until month-end.
Linh (AE): Confirmed. They asked for 3mo trial-ish term while legal finalizes reseller agreement. They will escalate PO internally.
Veronica Legal: If they want shorter term we need billing entity confirmed and T&Cs signed. We can do delegated signature (exec approval) if SOW unchanged.
Jake - RevOps: If they pay by CC we need billing contact + tax id for EU VAT. If PO later, we'll issue credit on next invoice.
PaymentBot: Invoice created: INV-2026-423 (draft). Link: https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-423
Maria (CS): @Suresh (Asterion) — can you confirm which billing entity?
Suresh (Asterion): Hi team — we'll use Asterion EU B.V., EU VAT ID NL987654321. PO is created but won't route to finance until Apr 2. Can CC now?
Jake - RevOps: OK if they provide card on file today we can provision but need PO by Apr 15 or we pause. Add vendor code 'AST-EU' to invoice.
Veronica Legal: Add clause: 'limited term 3 months; auto-renew at previous term unless notice' We need signoff from your legal.
Linh (AE): I'll send updated SOW + short-term amendment. Maria pls prepare e-sign link.
Maria (CS): Drafting DocuSign now. cc @Jake - RevOps for billing notes.
Maria (CS): DocuSign sent to Suresh: https://docusign.com/xyz — let me know if any fields fail.
Suresh (Asterion): Received. Signing now.

Maria (CS): :tada: All set, provisioning done. I'll track PO arrival and reconcile with RevOps. If PO not in by Apr 15, we'll convert to monthly billing.
Jake - RevOps: I'll set reminder and apply vendor code when PO hits.
Veronica Legal: Keep thread if any deviation from SOW.
Maria (CS): Capture feedback — they requested clearer renewal options in console. Filing feature request: FR-1422.
Linh (AE): Noted. Thanks team.
